match.userMessage:
A professional four-panel photographic character reference grid, maintaining absolute anatomical and stylistic consistency.

[LAYOUT]:
The grid comprises four distinct, technical views arranged horizontally:
- Panel 1 (Left): Full body frontal view, standing in a neutral pose
- Panel 2 (Center-Left): Close-up portrait frontal view (chest up)
- Panel 3 (Center-Right): Full body side profile view facing left
- Panel 4 (Right): Full body rear view

All attire, accessories, hair, and features must be perfectly consistent across all four panels.

[CHARACTER IDENTITY]:
Name: Mina
Age: Late 20s
Gender: Woman
Ethnicity: Unspecified

Physical Appearance:
A woman in her late 20s with an average height and softly angular features, tired eyes, and expressive brows. Her hair is medium-to-dark brown, shoulder length, and easily lifted by the rooftop wind. Her face visibly transforms from exhausted to amused after applying the lipstick.

Costume:
Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple dark top, dark trousers or jeans, and practical everyday shoes. The coral lipstick is carried in her jacket pocket after Scarlett gives it to her.

Distinguishing Features:
Green utility jacket, initially exhausted expression, and the coral lipstick tucked into her pocket. A fresh coral lip color becomes her defining visual transformation.

[ENVIRONMENT]:
Render the character in Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save style. Background: clean, seamless studio backdrop with no environmental detail — simple flat or gradient tone using the style's color palette: #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Color grading: Clean and bright with true-to-life color. Whites are crisp, skin tones warm and natural. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base. Mood: Fresh, sensory, and effortlessly cool. Reference look: modern social-first skincare-brand content, dewy minimalist beauty-brand visual identity, sun-soaked lifestyle beauty campaigns, playful color-blocked skincare content. All visual interest comes from the character, not the environment.

[OPTICAL & CAMERA SPECS]:
Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save style rendering. Camera approach: Dynamic mix of handheld and locked shots with consistent energy. Handheld with natural micro-movement for lifestyle moments -- hands interacting, daily rituals, real context. Quick-cut to locked beauty frames for hero product shots. Macro details on textures and surfaces. Overhead flat-lays directly above. Eye-level and slightly above angles. Shallow depth of field on tactile details. Energetic pacing -- no lingering, every frame earns its time. Maintain sharp focus and consistent character detail across all panels.

[LIGHTING]:
Bright natural window light with clean directional shadows. Direct on-camera flash for punchy editorial energy on select shots. No heavy diffusion -- let light feel real and immediate.
